editorial.description_en: The sea when the wind drops completely, which happens twice a day and lasts minutes.
editorial.description_ja: 風のやんだ沖のような、静かな青緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.640, C 0.086, h 214.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 沖 (oki, the offing) + 凪 (nagi, a dead calm). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Calm Offing" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 沖凪. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — nami-ma at ΔE00 6.2, kumori-nami at ΔE00 10.3, natsu-zora at ΔE00 10.5. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (34°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
